components.name: `InvoiceHash`
components.description: Same document → same hash; one changed character → different hash.

components.name: Duplicate invoice
components.description: Recording the same hash twice yields the original invoice + `DuplicateInvoiceDetected`, no second row.

components.name: At most one attempt
components.description: Two concurrent proposals for one invoice → exactly one `PaymentAttempt`; second gets `InvoiceNotPayable`.

components.name: Forbidden fields
components.description: Proposal with `payee_address`, `command`, `cap` or `threshold` → 422 `PROPOSAL_REJECTED`, zero attempts persisted.

components.name: Settled invoice
components.description: Proposal against a settled invoice → refused; no attempt row. (scenario 6, app layer)

components.name: Digest review
components.description: An invoice whose presented digest ≠ Mandate's verified digest triggers Mandate quarantine and the attempt is refused downstream. (scenario 2)

components.name: Refusal path
components.description: A denied determination sets the attempt `REFUSED` and the invoice back to outstanding, with no reservation committed.
